fields.title: Maps of the Inner Weather
fields.description: Historical nerve and brain engravings as quiet maps of feeling — how the mind has been drawn when words ran out. Crop, recolour, and let the lines become texture for Mind & Body.

fields.title: The Quiet Work of Care
fields.description: Wards, pharmacies, and hands on a pulse — public-domain scenes of tending. Soft browns and linen tones for Care posts that honour help without spectacle.

fields.title: What the Night Keeps
fields.description: Sleep, dream, and moonlit quiet from Wellcome and The Met — night as mood, not horror. Deep indigo accents for Night Thoughts and insomnia pieces.

fields.title: Looking Back at Yourself
fields.description: Quiet portraits and readers — self-regard without spectacle. Soft charcoal and rose-grey for body-image and Looking Closely stories.

fields.title: Paper Trails We Leave
fields.description: Calligraphy notebooks, ink letters, and writing manuals — the handmade page as house texture. Cream paper and iron-gall brown for Paper Trails.

fields.title: A Field Wide Enough to Breathe
fields.description: Open fields, gardens, and quiet landscapes as metaphors for recovery — room to inhale. Cypress green and sky gold for calm and reset pieces.
